public mixedPDO::getAttribute intattribute
This function returns the value of a database connection attribute. To retrieve PDOStatement attributes, refer to PDOStatement::getAttribute.
Only the generic attributes listed below can be retrieved with every driver. Whether any other attribute can be retrieved depends on the driver.

&reftitle.parameters;
attribute
One of the PDO::ATTR_* constants. The following generic attributes are handled by PDO itself and can be retrieved with every driver:
PDO::ATTR_CASE PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE PDO::ATTR_ORACLE_NULLS PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT PDO::ATTR_STATEMENT_CLASS PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES
All other attributes are handled by the driver. Which of them can be retrieved varies from driver to driver. This includes generic attributes such as PDO::ATTR_AUTOCOMMIT, PDO::ATTR_CLIENT_VERSION, PDO::ATTR_CONNECTION_STATUS, PDO::ATTR_SERVER_INFO, PDO::ATTR_SERVER_VERSION and PDO::ATTR_TIMEOUT, as well as driver specific attributes. Note that driver specific attributes must not be used with other drivers.
